messages.content: I think I've been afraid to fully commit to anything in case something better comes along.
Honestly, that's a genuinely modern kind of fear, actually - option-hoarding, some people call it. What's it costing you right now?
I think it's keeping me from actually going deep in my relationship.
That's honestly worth sitting with - depth requires closing some doors, and that trade-off is uncomfortable but usually necessary for anything to actually grow.
I think I'm ready to actually choose instead of keeping options open.
That's a genuinely big shift, honestly - commitment isn't giving something up, it's actually choosing to invest fully in what you already value.
